# T-1: Add plugin configuration

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Introduce plugin.repos and plugin.packages schema, defaults, config loading, and commit-pinning semantics.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Config validation accepts plugin.repos and plugin.packages with id/repo/commit/ref rules.
- Sync paths reject packages without commit.
- Plugin-owned config sections are validated only after enabled plugin schema/default contributions are loaded.

## Implementation Notes
Use a bootstrap load that accepts core fields plus plugin.repos/plugin.packages, loads enabled plugin manifests/runtime metadata, merges plugin config schema/default contributions, then validates plugin-owned sections such as workflow.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for config schema and migration cases.
